content: {"like": ["The second episode delivered more of what I had hoped for."], "dislike": ["The overall quality of writing declined toward the end of the original run.","Cute elements in the revival were rarely funny and often just cute.","The revival felt pointless and filled with filler, especially when it tried to become a musical.","Amy Palladino’s writing lost its edge.","The main character Lorelai Gilmore was missing, which disappointed fans.","Lauren Graham’s performance did not capture Lorelai’s spunk and spirit.","The show introduced political themes that felt forced and diminished goodwill."]}
